title: Southern Yank Pulled Pork BBQ
description: Try this easy pork BBQ recipe for boneless pork steeped in a slow cooker with sauces and seasonings. It's sweet and savory with just a hint of heat.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco®), or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Mix together onion, barbecue sauce, celery, water, ketchup, honey, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, hot pepper sauce, chili powder, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker until thoroughly combined. Place pork roast in the center of the cooker and spoon sauce over top. Cook on Low until pork is tender and can be easily pulled apart with a fork, 7 to 8 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 195 degrees F (91 degrees C).
Remove pork and shred with 2 forks. Return shredded meat to the sauce and serve.
